# cubepath_managed_database_plans (Data Source)

Lists the Managed Database plans, cheapest first. Sizes and prices are per node: a database costs price_per_hour x replicas.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `engine` (String) Only list plans of this engine: mysql, postgresql or valkey.
- `location_name` (String) Only list plans of this location (for example eu-bcn-1).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `plans` (Attributes List) Matching plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) vCPUs per node.
- `description` (String) Plan description.
- `engine` (String) Engine of the plan.
- `location_name` (String) Location of the plan.
- `max_replicas` (Number) Maximum number of nodes.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory per node, in GB.
- `name` (String) Plan name.
- `price_per_hour` (Number) Price per node per hour.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage per node, in GB.
- `uuid` (String) Plan UUID, used as plan_uuid.
